name: Virtual Monkeys
summary: Virtual Monkeys is a physics-based VR adventure where your hands are your only tools for navigation and survival. By pushing off surfaces and swinging through the environment, you master a high-speed locomotion system that feels both physical and incredibly rewarding. While much of the world is a vibrant playground for social interaction, players must also use their agility to navigate complex, mind-bending puzzles hidden throughout the maps.
